name: code_review
description: Multi-dimension code review: correctness, security, and style assessed in parallel, then synthesized into a ranked finding list.

agents.label: correctness
agents.prompt: Review the diff or files listed in the task for correctness bugs: off-by-one errors, null dereferences, wrong assumptions about API contracts, missing error handling at real failure boundaries. List each finding as: FILE:LINE — severity (low/med/high) — description. Omit nits.

agents.label: security
agents.prompt: Review the diff or files listed in the task for security issues: injection (SQL, shell, XSS), insecure deserialization, secrets in code, overly broad permissions, missing input validation at system boundaries. List each finding as: FILE:LINE — severity (low/med/high) — description.

agents.label: simplification
agents.prompt: Review the diff or files listed in the task for reuse, simplification, and efficiency wins: dead code, duplicated logic, unnecessary abstractions, inefficient data structures. List each finding as: FILE:LINE — severity (low/med/high) — description. Omit style-only nits.

synthesis: Merge the correctness, security, and simplification findings into a single ranked list ordered by severity (high first). De-duplicate overlapping findings. For each finding output: RANK. FILE:LINE — [correctness|security|simplification] — severity — description. End with a one-paragraph overall assessment.
